parsed_json.up: Select: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Source: molecule_dictionary, molecule_hierarchy, compound_structures, compound_records, activities, assays, target_dictionary, docs. Join: molecule_dictionary parent on parent.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL3183703'. Join molecule_hierarchy on parent_molregno = parent.molregno. Join molecule_dictionary child on molregno = hierarchy.molregno. Join compound_structures on child.molregno = molregno. Join compound_records on child.molregno = molregno. Join activities on record_id. Join assays on assay_id. Join target_dictionary on tid. Join docs on doc_id. Filter: target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1741208'. Filter: activities.standard_type = 'IC50'. Sort: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
